subject.facility_name: AUTUMN LAKE HEALTHCARE AT THE WILLOWS

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $184.15 per resident day (38.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -1.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $5,715,000, 100.0% of the $5,715,000 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $881,869, $28.42 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $372,599 (42.3%), allocated fringe $52,414 (5.9%), non-wage costs $456,856 (51.8%). Raw food was $247,131 ($7.96 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $185,483.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $363,626, $11.72 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $363,626 (100.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $230,283, $7.42 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $230,283 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost year 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075331/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2023 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
